page.layout: One page of text. Top: large title block, two lines in capitals, then an italic paragraph of intro text across the full width. Below: two columns of index entries, left and right, each read top to bottom. Bottom: a signature mark at the foot, centre-left. A small dot at the bottom right is a stain and is left out.

main_text.head: INDEX TITULORUM LEGUM XII. TABUL. AD PAN-

p.i: dectarum & Codicis seriem accommodatarum. Item Institutionum tam Ulpiani, quam Caii: in quo prior numerus ad Titul. alter ad pa-ginam refertur.

page.notes: Text is in two columns; the reading order above runs the left column first, then the right. The printed "Vlp." and "Caij" were read with u/v and i/j spelling normalised ("Ulp.", "Caii"). Printed "Captiuus" was read as "Captivus". Some lines in the right column (e.g. "Legibus") have doubtful final digits, but they are legible. A small dot at the bottom right corner is a stain, not text.
